instruction: In World Bank Open Data, which region out of China and its SAR (Special Administrative Region) has a crude birth rate of higher than 4 out of 1000, has a population growth lower than 1%, and has an annual GDP growth rate of higher than -5%, in 2022? If there is more than 1 region, then I want the region with lower than 5% in food price inflation in December 2022, according to the World Bank. If there is still more than 1 region then what is the region with a higher than 80 years old in life expectancy in 2022, according to Our World in Data?
